description: Syntax colors for TTS text in the resource editor (scene / item / walkthrough). RGBA 0-255. Edit this file to retheme highlighting; restart the editor to reload.

notes.default: Narration and other text outside markup
notes.styleContent: Text between a matched <tag>…</tag> pair (dark blue)
notes.voiceDialog: Text between a matched {{open}}…{{/close}} voice pair (light blue)
notes.markupError: Unclosed <… or {{voice:…}} stretch through end of text (red)
